title: Escalivada (Catalan Roasted Peppers, Aubergine and Onion)
summary: Red peppers, aubergines and onions roasted until meltingly soft, steamed, peeled and torn into strips, then dressed with olive oil, garlic, cider vinegar and smoked paprika.

ingredients.item: fine sea salt or table salt

steps.title: Roast the vegetables
steps.text: Heat the oven to 190 °C (170 °C fan). Halve the peppers, aubergines and unpeeled onions from top to bottom and lay them skin side up on the tray. Rub all over with 3 tbsp oil and roast for about 1 hour, until very soft and the skins are blistered and browned in places.

steps.title: Steam
steps.text: Cover the tray with the tea towel and leave for 15 min. The trapped steam loosens the skins so they slip off easily.

steps.title: Peel and tear
steps.text: Pull the skins, seeds and stems from the peppers, scoop the aubergine flesh from its skin, and peel the onions and separate their layers. Tear or cut everything into 1-2 cm strips and arrange them in the serving dish.

steps.title: Dress and rest
steps.text: Whisk the remaining 3 tbsp oil with the garlic, vinegar, paprika, salt and pepper, pour over the vegetables and turn gently. Leave for at least 1 hour, or refrigerate overnight, so the vegetables soak up the dressing. Serve at room temperature, scattered with parsley.

tips: Save any juices from the tray and add them to the dressing; they are full of flavour.
If you have a barbecue going, char the vegetables over the coals for the authentic smoky taste.
Serve on toasted bread, alongside grilled fish or chicken, or as part of a tapas spread.
storage: Refrigerate covered up to 4 days; it improves after a day. Bring back to room temperature before serving. Cool leftovers in a shallow container and refrigerate within 2 hours (within 1 hour on a day above 32°C).
